ShortDescription.Value: Manage Cemeteries, Crematoriums, hearses, or auto manage. Bonus Status report.

Publish.LongDescription:
**Magic Hearse + Funeral Director** does not turn off deathcare loop; normal vanilla deathcare systems run. See below for details.
- Control Crematoriums and Cemeteries without in-city bloat that reduces performance. - Choose if you want to self-manage with all your own settings for Processing rate, number of hearses, or Capacity of Cemeteries, and more. - Handle full Cemeteries as needed. - or if you prefer auto-clean of death notices. - Status report can be used with no other functions enabled! It is Worth checking out!
### Option 1: Funeral Director (Self manage)
Adjust Buildings:
- Processing rate (crematoriums) - Fleet size (max hearses per facility) - Cemetery storage multiplier - Hearse speed (pedal to the metal) - Change number of Max Workers. - Compatibility Toggle ✅ turn OFF workers if you prefer to use ConfigXML mod or other mod for death worker numbers. - Funeral Director does not run per-frame; sliders make changes, then mod goes idle, basically no city impact.
### Option 2: Automatic
- Removes corpses if they are waiting for a hearse. - Great for death-waves and notification spam. Lightweight design for best city performance. - This does not turn off death system, it's just a faster clear of death notices.
## Bonus Status Report - All major death stats - finally we know how many are Dead!! - Scan only happens in the Options menu or when a slider is used (lightweight, no city per-frame impact).
## Features - Toggle on/off without restarting the game. - Safe to remove any time. Uncheck both boxes to disable everything. - Disable other hearse mods to avoid conflicts! - Use either Auto-clean OR Self-manage (mutually exclusive). - No Harmony (more reliable on patch days).
## Support and Feedback - If the mod works for you, give it a Like! It's free! - Feedback: GitHub or Discord links on the right.
## Credits - River-Mochi: author - Inspired by Wayz's original Magical Hearse (retired) - yenyang: technical consultant - Toud: Polish translation review - StarQ: tech advisory - Obelix, Toud, Necko1996: release testing, screenshots
### 13+ Languages Hello, Bonjour, Hallo, Hola, Ciao, こんにちは, 안녕하세요, 你好, 你好, Cześć, Olá, Привіт, Xin chào
## How it works
- Magic mode ✅ if the citizen is flagged as dead and needs transport, it's cleaned up. Looks like magic but the secret is flags. - Mod does not stop death - it's just very fast corpse cleanup. - Safe removal: if you use Auto-Magic, nothing persists - done. If you used sliders, set sliders to 100% and uncheck Funeral Director, save city one time (fastest reset). - Bonus: disable all checkboxes ✅, turns off all mod death work, and still see real Status reports in the Options menu. - Status only works when inside the menu; no performance impact to in-game city.
Publish.ChangeLog: - Added languages Vietnamese, Ukrainian, Portuguese Portugal. - Settings now save in a standard MagicHearse folder. - Option settings to save instantly. - The defaults button saves immediately.
